decisions.reason: LLM choice 'Geography - Get Continents' is more relevant to geographic and tourism information than unrelated 'Stars API'.
Semantic top-1 'Stars API - Planet list' is unrelated but LLM choice 'Addressr' is specific to Australian addresses, not tourist attractions in Brazil, so it does not clearly improve relevance.
Semantic top-1 'Addressr' API is unrelated to image search; LLM choice 'Web Search - spellCheck' is for spell checking, not image search, so neither fits well; keep semantic top-1 by default.
